text:
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: page fired for service=runtime-prod alert=error-rate-high (PD12345). Notifying @ravi. Trigger: errors > 5% over 1m.

ravi: acked. i'm on it — pinging logs and metrics.

noah: i'm nearby, on mobile. any indication of customer impact yet?

ravi: realtime graphs show a sharp spike 20:14->20:16. 5xxs mostly gRPC UNAVAILABLE from model-shard-a, concurrent failures across 3 hosts. looks like KV miss storm.

sofia: checking infra — there was a rollout started ~20:09 (small canary). autoscaler did a rapid scale-up then several pods cycled. will check pod logs:
```
kubectl -n runtime-prod get pods -l app=runtime -o wide
kubectl -n runtime-prod logs runtime-pod-7f8 --since=10m | grep -i kvcache
```

ravi: i'm going to flip traffic to fallback model variant and pause canary. doing `route:set fallback=true` now.

maria: support: one customer reported elevated latency and a handful of failures at 20:15; they said volume small but visible. filing ticket #SUP-842.

pagerduty-bot: Alert auto-resolved at 20:17 (PD12345). Note: alert flapped — resolved without manual close.

ravi: confirmed auto-resolved. fallback routing completed around 20:16:30 and failed pod count dropped. we still saw short-lived 503s for maybe 10-30s for that customer. no broad outage.

noah: i'll keep watch for another 15m. can we silence this alert rule temporarily while we triage? it's noisy when warmups + rollouts overlap.

sofia: +1 to silencing for 15m. root cause hypothesis: concurrent canary rollout triggered cache rewarm on multiple nodes, autoscaler reacted causing transient capacity juggling -> increased RPC errors. also some compaction GC logs lined up.

ravi: action items: 1) create post-incident ticket in eng-runtime (assign: sofia) 2) update runbook with warmup-suppression and alert window bump 3) add short-term suppression for rule errors>5% in 5m if it's correlated with rollout label. i'm adding TODOs.

maria: will inform the affected customer that it was a brief flapping event; no sustained data loss, apologies for the blip.

sofia: suggested runbook changes: increase alerting evaluation window from 1m->3m, add dedupe across shards, and add a label-based suppression when `rollout=true`. also add a checklist to pause canary if KV warmup errors spike.

ravi: good. please also add a metric to detect concurrent rewarm across >2 nodes.

noah: silenced alert group eng-runtime/errors for 15m. monitoring at :eyes:.

pagerduty-bot: Incident PD12345 closed (auto-resolve).

ravi: handing off watch to @noah for the next 30m — i'm stepping away. thanks everyone. :thumbsup: 

noah: ack — i'll escalate back if it flaps again. will follow up with a short blameless writeup and link the new ticket.

sofia: TL;DR: transient flapping error spike during canary + autoscaler churn. resolved by fallback routing and autoscaler settling. low customer impact (single-customer latency blip). follow-ups: runbook + alert tuning + metric for concurrent rewarm.

maria: closing loop with support and adding note to SUP-842.

ravi: thanks all. filing post-incident items now.
